# Board Gallery

> A creative asset board gallery with infinite scroll, optimized image
> loading, and a component-driven UI, built with Next.js and TypeScript.

Board Gallery demonstrates infinite-scroll pagination, responsive image
optimization (blur placeholders, lazy loading, `sizes` tuning), and a
modular component architecture. Data is served from a local mock fixture
layer with seeded picsum.photos images, so the app runs standalone with
no external API or credentials required.

## Technical implementation

- **Framework:** Next.js 14 (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- **Data fetching:** React Query with cursor-based pagination
- **Images:** Next.js `<Image />` with responsive `sizes`, blur
  placeholders, and lazy loading

Source and full documentation: https://github.com/Younique98/board-gallery
